identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-A] C-SDLC v3 contract and construction decision

values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Prove the bounded V3-A design, retained authority boundary, exact predecessor scope, and issue-owned validation entrypoints are ready.

Prove contract shape, predecessor coverage, authority and rollback boundaries, and the proportional-lifecycle matrix; fail on unjustified retained gates, duplicate authority, repeated child proof, or a default path wider than one design gate, focused validation, one independent implementation review, and closeout.
lanes.defer_reason: Runs after the V3-A contract, proportional-lifecycle decision, and minimal crate boundary exist; readiness must not manufacture implementation proof.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on ambiguous v2 coexistence, missing or duplicated predecessor coverage, unreviewable rollback, undeclared scope, or any implied authority cutover.
